---
title: "Cell Type Annotation"
---

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE)
source("R/read_manifest.R")
source("R/read_summary.R")
source("R/plot_helpers.R")

result_dir <- "data"
manifest <- read_manifest(result_dir)

annotation_step <- find_step(manifest, "annotation")
annotation_summary <- if (!is.null(annotation_step)) read_step_summary(result_dir, annotation_step$summary) else NULL
```

## Annotation Summary

```{r annotation-status}
if (is.null(annotation_summary)) {
  cat("Annotation summary not available.")
} else {
  cat(paste0("Status: **", annotation_summary$status, "**  "))
  cat(paste0("Timestamp: ", annotation_summary$timestamp))
}
```

## Annotation Plots

```{r annotation-plots, fig.cap="SingleR cell type annotation", out.width="100%"}
if (!is.null(annotation_summary)) {
  img_path <- find_artifact(annotation_summary, "png")
  if (!is.null(img_path)) {
    display_image(result_dir, img_path)
  } else {
    cat("No annotation plot found.")
  }
}
```

## Cell Proportions

```{r proportion-plots, fig.cap="Cell type proportions by group/sample", out.width="100%"}
if (!is.null(annotation_summary)) {
  # Look for proportion plot artifact
  prop_artifact <- annotation_summary$artifacts[sapply(annotation_summary$artifacts, function(x) x$type == "dir" && grepl("proportions", x$path))]
  if (length(prop_artifact) > 0) {
    prop_dir <- file.path(result_dir, prop_artifact[[1]]$path)
    prop_png <- list.files(prop_dir, pattern = "\\.png$", full.names = TRUE)[1]
    if (!is.na(prop_png)) {
      knitr::include_graphics(prop_png)
    } else {
      cat("No proportion plot found.")
    }
  } else {
    cat("No proportion plot artifact found.")
  }
}
```
